## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated fixture-based tests where appropriate
- [ ] Ran the relevant Python and web checks
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/validate_public_release.py --allow-dirty`
- [ ] Updated documentation where behaviour or safety boundaries changed

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No real target data, credentials, raw scan output, or private logs are included
- [ ] The change preserves explicit Scope confirmation and bounded collection
